test_title: PYST 8: SSC MTS 2023 - English (Held On: 05 Sept, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains an error.

They had been dancing / for an hour / when our dance teacher / had arrived.
solution:
The correct answer is: **had arrived**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentence uses the** past perfect continuous tense** ("had been dancing") to describe an action that was ongoing in the past.
 
• The phrase "when our dance teacher had arrived" incorrectly uses the past perfect tense ("had arrived") instead of the **simple past tense**.
 
• The correct phrase should be "when our dance teacher arrived" to indicate that the arrival of the dance teacher interrupted the ongoing action of dancing.
 
• The sentence contains two clauses: the main clause and the subordinate (dependent) clause.
 
 
• Main clause: "They had been dancing for an hour"
 
• Subordinate clause: "when our dance teacher arrived"
 
 
 
• The use of the **past simple tense** in the **subordinate clause** (arrived) is essential because it marks the specific point in time at which the ongoing action (dancing) met an interruption or new event.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is Option 4.

Correct sentence: *They had been dancing for an hour when our dance teacher arrived.*
